name: Retention policies and tags (MRM)
description: Lists Exchange messaging records management retention policies with each tag they link to, and each tag's type, age limit, retention action and whether retention is enabled.

parameters.name: IncludeUnlinkedTags
parameters.label: Include tags no policy links to
parameters.help: Also list retention tags that no returned policy links to. They are NotLinked only when every policy's links were returned and resolved.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read retention policies and tags, such as View-Only Organization Management.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.

A policy's tag link is Resolved only when it is exactly one returned tag's Name, Identity or DistinguishedName as Exchange returns them; anything else is Unresolved and its tag settings are not shown.
Which mailboxes use each policy is not read here; the holds and retention item shows each mailbox's retention policy.
An age limit not returned is Unknown, except on a tag whose retention Exchange reports as disabled, where it is NotApplicable.
Microsoft Purview retention policies and retention labels are not read.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
